title: RecordRoute: Auditing Agent Failures with Localization-Guided Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2611.33022v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Auditing failed agent executions requires identifying the responsible actor, the earliest decisive step, and the error mode. Representative supervised methods either focus on step localization or predict multiple attribution targets from shared trajectory representations. These methods do not use the localization result to select the text for mode diagnosis. To address this limitation, we propose RecordRoute, which couples comparative localization with local diagnosis. Specifically, it represents each record with word and character features and learns to rank records through comparisons within each trajectory. The selected record supplies the actor and step, while its text and metadata drive mode prediction. On controlled-injection Who&When Pro, RecordRoute outperforms StepFinder and ASCon on all four official metrics. With actor and step predictions fixed, local diagnosis reaches 77.47% pooled joint accuracy versus 69.28% for full-trace

translated_title: RecordRoute：基于定位引导诊断的智能体失败审计方法
translated_abstract: 审计失败的智能体执行需要识别责任主体、最早的决定性步骤以及错误模式。现有的代表性监督方法要么专注于步骤定位，要么从共享的轨迹表示中预测多个归因目标，这些方法并未利用定位结果来选择用于模式诊断的文本。为解决这一局限，我们提出了RecordRoute，它将比较式定位与局部诊断相结合。具体而言，该方法使用词级和字符级特征表示每条记录，并通过轨迹内部的比较学习对记录进行排序。被选中的记录提供责任主体和步骤信息，而其文本和元数据则驱动错误模式预测。在受控注入的Who&When Pro基准上，RecordRoute在全部四项官方指标上均优于StepFinder和ASCon。在固定主体和步骤预测的条件下，局部诊断达到77.47%的合并联合准确率，而全轨迹方法仅为69.28%。
tldr: RecordRoute将比较式记录定位与基于所选记录文本和元数据的局部错误模式诊断相耦合，实现了“先定位再诊断”的智能体失败审计框架，在Who&When Pro基准的全部指标上超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: RecordRoute couples comparative record-level localization with local error-mode diagnosis driven by the selected record's text and metadata, achieving superior performance over prior methods on all metrics of the Who&When Pro agent failure auditing benchmark.
